summary: Change is a one-line branch in src/ui/App.tsx openTable: replaceState instead of pushState when history.state already carries a string tlhTable. history.state is writable only by same-origin script (or restored by the browser from this app's own entries); entryKey only reads a property with a null-safe type check, and the value is compared/typeof-checked, never evaluated, rendered, logged, or used as a URL (replaceState/pushState pass '' with no URL argument, so no open-redirect or URL injection). The written key still comes from newTableKey (CSPRNG per TASK-2.20). A forged state could at most cause one history entry to be replaced instead of pushed, a UX-only effect with no attacker gain. No new dependencies; the e2e spec and docs changes carry no security surface. No findings.
